expectedBehavior: Inspect the active workload-set and iOS manifest packages without installing them into a .NET root.
observedBehavior: Microsoft.NET.Workloads.10.0.400 10.401.1 maps Microsoft.NET.Sdk.iOS to 27.0.10722/10.0.100. Microsoft.NET.Sdk.iOS.Manifest-10.0.100 27.0.10722 exposes workload ID ios, iOS runtime packs, and Windows SDK aliases only.
limitations: Package inspection does not prove manifest precedence, installation, repair, or uninstall behavior.
No Linux host mapping was observed in the official manifest.
Transitive Mono/toolchain packs remain to be inventoried.
nextDecision: Use the inspected schema as input to a disposable M1 conflict and lifecycle experiment; do not generate a custom manifest before that experiment is designed.

commands.command: Download and inspect Microsoft.NET.Workloads.10.0.400 10.401.1 and Microsoft.NET.Sdk.iOS.Manifest-10.0.100 27.0.10722 with unzip.
